description: Use this when a person gives a booking reference and wants to cancel it. The first call returns a summary to show the person and a code, and changes nothing. Call again with the code only when they agree. A booking not yet paid is cancelled at once; a paid one goes to the team, who confirm it with the person.

booking_key.description: The booking_key from hold_time or request_care, when this conversation made the booking. Without it, the answer leaves out the confirm link and any change goes to the person to confirm.

confirmation_code.description: Leave it out the first time. Send the code from the first answer once the person agrees.

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
